en: Monochrome illustrated postcard showing a dramatic front view of a steam locomotive rushing toward the viewer on railway tracks that emerge from the pages of a large open book. Above the train is a winged railway wheel symbolizing speed or progress. On the left side are rail-related details such as signals or masts. In the foreground the open book contains years and German text, written with a quill by a hand at the right edge. The lower part of the card is blank for a message. The illustration is signed at the bottom right with a name and the date 1920.
